The '''Utor Shock''' was a conflict that occurred<ref name="TEGtW" /> in the vicinity of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim's]] [[Utor system/Legends|Utor system]]<ref name="TEAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> in which the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Judicial Forces/Legends|Judicial Forces]] had a key role that took place in [[602 BBY]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Utor Shock was mentioned in [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]]'s [[2012]] reference guide ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''.<ref name="TEGtW" />
